svg.title: wtfgif speedup over a JavaScript and a native GIF encoder
svg.desc: For 10 RGBA workloads, paired bars on a logarithmic axis show how many times faster wtfgif's first encode in its fastest mode is than image-q plus omggif and than sharp. Labels give all three median encode times, wtfgif's output size relative to each, each encoder's RGB quality, and wtfgif's smallest mode time and size.

g.text: wtfgif fastest-mode speedup on 10 RGBA workloads
Cold-cache first real encode after initialization · 40 fresh Node processes per encoder · logarithmic axis, longer is faster
vs image-q + omggif (JavaScript): 119×–593× (230× geometric mean)
vs sharp (libvips), effort 1, no dither (native): 13×–132× (36× geometric mean)
